name: Exact Records of Product-Attachment Test Pieces
statement: Let $D$ be a nonempty ample common section, let nonempty ample $K\subseteq D$, and put $C_K=P_R(D,K)$ using the rooted attachment factor. Then $\operatorname{Tr}_D(C_K)$ consists exactly of the pairs $(\pi,K)$ such that every edge $xy$ with $x\in K$ and $y\in D\setminus K$ has $y$ before $x$ in $\pi$. If $K$ peels, then for every ample piece $A$ over $D$, the gluing $A\oplus_D C_K$ peels if and only if $A$ peels down to $K$.
proof: Restriction to each $R$-fiber forces every vertex of $K$ to be active, while vertices outside $K$ have no private neighbors. Missing mixed squares force the displayed edge precedences. Conversely, the precedences let one commute nonadjacent deletions until $D\setminus K$ precedes $K$; a peeling of $R$ can then be executed layer by layer around the prescribed order. The testing equivalence is the product-attachment theorem applied to $P_R(A,K)$.
